note: Written from sql/12_dimension_users.sql (usp_Insights_Dimension_Users). Verified by SourceMapVerificationTests - every query must return exactly what the report's procedure returned. Overdue and logins are live figures: a check run later can differ slightly from the report.
setup: DECLARE @UserID INT = {UserID};
DECLARE @CustomerID INT = {CustomerID};
DECLARE @WindowStart DATETIME = '{WindowStart}';
DECLARE @WindowEnd DATETIME = '{WindowEnd}';
DECLARE @AsOf DATETIME = GETDATE();
-- Step 1. Obligations this user is allowed to see: their permitted locations and categories,
--         active locations only, nothing deleted (ComplianceInstance, CustomerBranch, Compliance, Act, EntitiesAssignment).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#inst') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #inst;
SELECT s.ComplianceInstanceID, s.BranchID, s.Imprisonment INTO #inst
FROM dbo.tvfInsightsScopedInstances(@UserID, @CustomerID) s;
-- Step 2. Keep only obligations with at least one due date inside the report period (ComplianceScheduleOn.ScheduleOn).
DELETE i FROM #inst i
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ComplianceScheduleOn cso
WHERE cso.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
AND cso.ScheduleOn >= @WindowStart AND cso.ScheduleOn < @WindowEnd);
-- Step 3. Obligations overdue right now: past due and not closed, or never touched (ComplianceScheduleOn, ComplianceTransaction).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ovd') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ovd;
SELECT DISTINCT o.ComplianceInstanceID INTO #ovd
FROM dbo.tvfInsightsOverdueSchedules(@CustomerID, @AsOf) o
JOIN #inst i ON i.ComplianceInstanceID = o.ComplianceInstanceID;
-- Step 4. Who is assigned to each obligation (ComplianceAssignment). RoleID 3 = performer, 4 = reviewer.
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#asg') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #asg;
SELECT DISTINCT ca.UserID, ca.RoleID, ca.ComplianceInstanceID INTO #asg
FROM ComplianceAssignment ca
JOIN #inst i ON i.ComplianceInstanceID = ca.ComplianceInstanceID
WHERE ca.UserID > 0;
-- Step 5. Completed performer work and its timing: record date minus due date, in days
--         (ComplianceScheduleOn, ComplianceTransaction, status dictionary).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#done') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #done;
SELECT a.UserID, d.Timeliness, DATEDIFF(day, cso.ScheduleOn, t.Dated) AS DaysLate INTO #done
FROM #asg a
JOIN ComplianceScheduleOn cso ON cso.ComplianceInstanceID = a.ComplianceInstanceID
JOIN ComplianceTransaction t ON t.ComplianceScheduleOnID = cso.ID
JOIN dbo.vInsightsStatusCurrent d ON d.StatusId = t.StatusId
WHERE a.RoleID = 3 AND d.ClosureClass = 'completed' AND d.Timeliness IS NOT NULL;
-- Step 6. Logins in the last 12 months, matched by email ([User], UserLoginTrack).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#login') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #login;
SELECT u.ID AS UserID, COUNT(l.ID) AS Logins12m INTO #login
FROM [User] u
LEFT JOIN UserLoginTrack l ON l.Email = u.Email AND l.LoginDate >= DATEADD(MONTH, -12, @AsOf) AND l.LoginDate < @AsOf
WHERE u.CustomerID = @CustomerID AND u.IsDeleted = 0
GROUP BY u.ID;

checks.name: All obligations in the report
checks.tables: Steps 1-2: permitted, active obligations with a due date in the period.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst;

checks.name: Obligations with at least one person assigned
checks.tables: ComplianceAssignment, each obligation counted once.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ComplianceInstanceID) AS Value FROM #asg;

checks.name: Obligations with nobody assigned
checks.tables: All obligations minus assigned obligations.
query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #inst) - (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ComplianceInstanceID) FROM #asg) AS Value;

checks.name: Overdue obligations
checks.tables: Step 3: overdue right now. Live - can move between runs.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #ovd;

checks.name: Overall overdue rate (%)
checks.tables: Overdue obligations / all obligations x 100.
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #inst) = 0 THEN 0
ELSE 100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #ovd) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #inst) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value;

checks.name: People in the report (people holding assigned work)
checks.tables: ComplianceAssignment, distinct UserID.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS Value FROM #asg;

checks.name: Total assigned load across people and roles
checks.tables: Each person's distinct obligations, added up (one obligation can count for two people).
query: SELECT ISNULL(SUM(n), 0) AS Value FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ComplianceInstanceID) AS n FROM #asg GROUP BY UserID) x;

checks.name: Obligations with exactly one reviewer
checks.tables: ComplianceAssignment RoleID 4, obligations with only one distinct reviewer.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM (
SELECT ComplianceInstanceID FROM #asg WHERE RoleID = 4
GROUP BY ComplianceInstanceID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) = 1) x;

checks.name: People with performer work
checks.tables: ComplianceAssignment RoleID 3, distinct UserID.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS Value FROM #asg WHERE RoleID = 3;

checks.name: People with reviewer work
checks.tables: ComplianceAssignment RoleID 4, distinct UserID.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS Value FROM #asg WHERE RoleID = 4;

checks.name: Median performer load
checks.tables: Middle value of each performer's distinct performer obligations.
query: WITH p AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT ComplianceInstanceID) AS n FROM #asg WHERE RoleID = 3 GROUP BY UserID)
SELECT TOP 1 CAST(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CAST(n AS FLOAT)) OVER () AS DECIMAL(9,2)) AS Value FROM p;

checks.name: Median recording timing, all people (days; + = late)
checks.tables: Step 5, gaps over 365 days left out.
query: SELECT TOP 1 CAST(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CAST(DaysLate AS FLOAT)) OVER () AS DECIMAL(9,1)) AS Value
FROM #done WHERE ABS(DaysLate) <= 365;

checks.name: Completed events left out for a gap over 365 days
checks.tables: Step 5.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #done WHERE ABS(DaysLate) > 365;

checks.name: Median on-time share across people
checks.tables: Step 5: each person's on-time events / completed events x 100, then the middle value.
query: WITH q AS (SELECT UserID, CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Timeliness = 'on_time' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS OnTimePct
FROM #done GROUP BY UserID)
SELECT TOP 1 CAST(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY OnTimePct) OVER () AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value FROM q;

checks.name: A person's total obligations (any role)
checks.tables: ComplianceAssignment for this UserID, each obligation once.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ComplianceInstanceID) AS Value FROM #asg WHERE UserID = {RowKey};

checks.name: A person's performer obligations
checks.tables: ComplianceAssignment, RoleID 3, this UserID.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ComplianceInstanceID) AS Value FROM #asg WHERE UserID = {RowKey} AND RoleID = 3;

checks.name: A person's reviewer obligations
checks.tables: ComplianceAssignment, RoleID 4, this UserID.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ComplianceInstanceID) AS Value FROM #asg WHERE UserID = {RowKey} AND RoleID = 4;

checks.name: A person's obligations in other roles
checks.tables: ComplianceAssignment, RoleID other than 3 or 4, this UserID.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ComplianceInstanceID) AS Value FROM #asg WHERE UserID = {RowKey} AND RoleID NOT IN (3, 4);

checks.name: A person's overdue obligations
checks.tables: This person's obligations that are in step 3 (overdue now).
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.ComplianceInstanceID) AS Value
FROM #asg a JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = a.ComplianceInstanceID WHERE a.UserID = {RowKey};

checks.name: A person's overdue rate (%)
checks.tables: Overdue obligations / total obligations x 100, for this person.
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT a.ComplianceInstanceID) = 0 THEN 0
ELSE 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.ComplianceInstanceID IS NOT NULL THEN a.ComplianceInstanceID END)
/ COUNT(DISTINCT a.ComplianceInstanceID) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #asg a LEFT JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = a.ComplianceInstanceID WHERE a.UserID = {RowKey};

checks.name: A person's obligations with a possible prison term
checks.tables: Compliance.Imprisonment = 1, this person's obligations.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.ComplianceInstanceID) AS Value
FROM #asg a JOIN #inst i ON i.ComplianceInstanceID = a.ComplianceInstanceID
WHERE a.UserID = {RowKey} AND i.Imprisonment = 1;

checks.name: A person's overdue obligations with a possible prison term
checks.tables: Compliance.Imprisonment = 1 and overdue now, this person's obligations.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.ComplianceInstanceID) AS Value
FROM #asg a JOIN #inst i ON i.ComplianceInstanceID = a.ComplianceInstanceID
JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = a.ComplianceInstanceID
WHERE a.UserID = {RowKey} AND i.Imprisonment = 1;

checks.name: Locations a person covers
checks.tables: Distinct CustomerBranch of this person's obligations.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.BranchID) AS Value
FROM #asg a JOIN #inst i ON i.ComplianceInstanceID = a.ComplianceInstanceID WHERE a.UserID = {RowKey};

checks.name: A person's logins in the last 12 months
checks.tables: Step 6 (UserLoginTrack by email). Live - can move by a login or two.
query: SELECT ISNULL((SELECT Logins12m FROM #login WHERE UserID = {RowKey}), 0) AS Value;

checks.name: A person's completed performer events
checks.tables: Step 5, this person.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #done WHERE UserID = {RowKey};

checks.name: A person's on-time completed events
checks.tables: Step 5, this person, status timeliness = on_time.
query: SELECT ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN Timeliness = 'on_time' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Value FROM #done WHERE UserID = {RowKey};

checks.name: A person's on-time share (%)
checks.tables: On-time events / completed events x 100. Empty (no reading) when nothing was completed.
query: SELECT CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Timeliness = 'on_time' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #done WHERE UserID = {RowKey};

checks.name: A person's median recording timing (days; + = late)
checks.tables: Step 5, this person, gaps over 365 days left out. No row = no reading.
query: SELECT TOP 1 CAST(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CAST(DaysLate AS FLOAT)) OVER () AS DECIMAL(9,1)) AS Value
FROM #done WHERE UserID = {RowKey} AND ABS(DaysLate) <= 365;

checks.name: Events behind a person's timing median
checks.tables: Step 5, this person, gaps over 365 days left out.
query: SELECT NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS Value FROM #done WHERE UserID = {RowKey} AND ABS(DaysLate) <= 365;

checks.name: Share of assigned obligations covered by the 10 busiest people (%)
checks.tables: Obligations held by the 10 people with the most obligations, each counted once / all assigned obligations x 100. If people are tied at 10th place the pick can differ.
query: SELECT CAST(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT a.ComplianceInstanceID) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ComplianceInstanceID) FROM #asg) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #asg a
WHERE a.UserID IN (SELECT TOP 10 UserID FROM #asg GROUP BY UserID ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ComplianceInstanceID) DESC);

checks.name: Overdue rate per login-frequency group (%)
checks.tables: Group = logins in 12 months (100+ power, 26+ frequent, 6+ moderate, 1+ seldom, 0 never). Group's overdue obligations / group's obligations x 100.
query: WITH u AS (SELECT a.UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT a.ComplianceInstanceID) AS Instances,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.ComplianceInstanceID IS NOT NULL THEN a.ComplianceInstanceID END) AS Overdue
FROM #asg a LEFT JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = a.ComplianceInstanceID GROUP BY a.UserID),
b AS (SELECT u.Instances, u.Overdue, CASE WHEN ISNULL(lg.Logins12m, 0) >= 100 THEN 'power' WHEN ISNULL(lg.Logins12m, 0) >= 26 THEN 'frequent'
WHEN ISNULL(lg.Logins12m, 0) >= 6 THEN 'moderate' WHEN ISNULL(lg.Logins12m, 0) >= 1 THEN 'seldom' ELSE 'never' END AS [Key]
FROM u LEFT JOIN #login lg ON lg.UserID = u.UserID)
SELECT [Key], CAST(CASE WHEN SUM(Instances) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0 * SUM(Overdue) / SUM(Instances) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM b GROUP BY [Key];

checks.name: People per login-frequency group
checks.tables: Same groups as C2, people counted.
query: WITH u AS (SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM #asg)
SELECT CASE WHEN ISNULL(lg.Logins12m, 0) >= 100 THEN 'power' WHEN ISNULL(lg.Logins12m, 0) >= 26 THEN 'frequent'
WHEN ISNULL(lg.Logins12m, 0) >= 6 THEN 'moderate' WHEN ISNULL(lg.Logins12m, 0) >= 1 THEN 'seldom' ELSE 'never' END AS [Key],
COUNT(*) AS Value
FROM u LEFT JOIN #login lg ON lg.UserID = u.UserID
GROUP BY CASE WHEN ISNULL(lg.Logins12m, 0) >= 100 THEN 'power' WHEN ISNULL(lg.Logins12m, 0) >= 26 THEN 'frequent'
WHEN ISNULL(lg.Logins12m, 0) >= 6 THEN 'moderate' WHEN ISNULL(lg.Logins12m, 0) >= 1 THEN 'seldom' ELSE 'never' END;

checks.name: People holding current work while not logging in often
checks.tables: People with fewer than 26 logins in 12 months whose on-time share is at or above the median on-time share (U14). People with no completed work are left out.
query: WITH q AS (SELECT UserID, CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Timeliness = 'on_time' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS OnTimePct
FROM #done GROUP BY UserID),
m AS (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY OnTimePct) OVER () AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Med FROM q)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value
FROM q CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN #login lg ON lg.UserID = q.UserID
WHERE ISNULL(lg.Logins12m, 0) < 26 AND q.OnTimePct >= m.Med;

checks.name: Overdue obligations with a possible prison term, all people added up
checks.tables: Each person's overdue prison-term obligations (P8), added up.
query: SELECT SUM(n) AS Value FROM (
SELECT a.UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT a.ComplianceInstanceID) AS n
FROM #asg a JOIN #inst i ON i.ComplianceInstanceID = a.ComplianceInstanceID
JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = a.ComplianceInstanceID
WHERE i.Imprisonment = 1 GROUP BY a.UserID) x;

checks.name: Highest overdue prison-term count held by one person
checks.tables: The largest P8 value across people.
query: SELECT MAX(n) AS Value FROM (
SELECT a.UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT a.ComplianceInstanceID) AS n
FROM #asg a JOIN #inst i ON i.ComplianceInstanceID = a.ComplianceInstanceID
JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = a.ComplianceInstanceID
WHERE i.Imprisonment = 1 GROUP BY a.UserID) x;
